metric_definitions.gini: Gini coefficient over assignment counts; 0 is equal
metric_definitions.normalized_entropy: Shannon entropy divided by log(entity count); 1 is equal
metric_definitions.top_10pct_share: share held by ceil(10% of entities) with highest load
